name: AutoForge
notes:
**AutoForge 0.3.6**

- **Phone app no longer crashes** when it has no PC address yet: it now asks you to connect to your PC instead of showing "Unexpected Application Error".
- If a screen ever fails, you get **Reload** and **Sign out / change server** buttons instead of an error page.
- Tip: to run workflows and approve videos from anywhere, use **Settings → Phone** on the PC and scan the QR code - it opens in Safari, no app needed.
- **iPhone:** unsigned FlowForge.ipa for sideloading with AltStore or Sideloadly. Android APK and Windows installer included.

### Install
- **Windows:** FlowForge-Setup.exe
- **Android:** FlowForge.apk (allow installing apps from your browser)
- **iPhone:** FlowForge.ipa - unsigned, install with AltStore or Sideloadly

downloads.label: Android app (.apk)
downloads.requirements: Android 7 or newer - allow "Install unknown apps" for your browser

downloads.label: iPhone app (.ipa)
downloads.requirements: iOS 15 or newer - unsigned: install with AltStore or Sideloadly using your Apple ID
